calculator_engine: function impliedVol(mktPrice,S,K,T,r,isCall){let sigma=0.3;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){const t=T/365;const d1=(Math.log(S/K)+(r/100+sigma*sigma/2)*t)/(sigma*Math.sqrt(t));const d2=d1-sigma*Math.sqrt(t);function N(x){return(1+erf(x/Math.SQRT2))/2;}const price=isCall?S*N(d1)-K*Math.exp(-r/100*t)*N(d2):K*Math.exp(-r/100*t)*N(-d2)-S*N(-d1);const vega=S*Math.sqrt(t)*Math.exp(-d1*d1/2)/Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI);sigma=sigma-(price-mktPrice)/vega;if(Math.abs(price-mktPrice)<0.001)break;}return{iv:(sigma*100).toFixed(2)};}
